score_meaning: Project chosen evidence applicability and practical setup preference score. Not a removal percentage, efficiency prediction or probability.

suitability.0: Inspected evidence demonstrates failure for the exact objective
suitability.1: Relevant pollutant and formulation evidence or eligible experimental ML, but no fully matched observed treatment objective
suitability.2: A reported removal observation matches all five operating inputs and supports the declared removal target

setup.0: Documented route conflicts with explicitly available setup
setup.1: Partial setup match or unresolved wavelength, formulation or conditions
setup.2: Declared laboratory setup meets the checked route requirements

recovery.0: The documented recovery method is explicitly unavailable
recovery.1: Analytical separation reported without demonstrated complete recovery
recovery.2: Documented laboratory separation method is available for the specified profile
recovery.unknown: Recovery not demonstrated or equipment unknown

design_assumptions: Batch mixing is a prototype setup requirement; where the abstract does not describe agitation, this is an engineering assumption rather than an extracted experiment parameter.
Unknown criterion ratings span zero to two; no midpoint or weight renormalisation is used.
One family row describes a named chosen profile, not universal performance of every material in that family.
Conditional candidates are ranked only when allow_conditional_ranking is explicitly true.
The policy never gives extra score merely because a candidate has an ML prediction.
Known mismatched conditions imply conditional transferability, not proof of poor removal.
